notes: The optional broad corpus grep required many promisor fetches and was stopped after exact source pointers were obtained; absence of other work is not claimed.

Quick jobs overlapped read-only Git retrieval and sparse materialization; subprocess startup dominates timing. Raw observations were retained.
Initial PDF rendering emitted a non-writable font cache warning and a Python escape warning; an explicit writable cache and escaped template path resolved these for final rendering.
An importlib render helper needed the report directory on sys.path; the corrected render completed.
A patch context check refused an edit before applying it; the subsequent scoped patch succeeded.
Shared-batch accounting was added post hoc as exact derivation from retained roots; fits and solver observations were not changed.
GitHub authentication probe returned HTTP 401; no push or PR creation was attempted under that failed identity.
Pre-archive whitespace checks flagged renderer-generated SVG trailing spaces and CSV CRLF; only derived sources were normalized. Raw pilot artifacts remain unchanged.
